answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method across three diverse datasets encompassing human-generated content: emails, news articles and product reviews.

answer_2.quote: Automated Evaluation. We leverage GPT-4o as our automated evaluator due to its demonstrated capabilities in assessing human-written text and capturing stylistic nuances.

answer_3.quote: Automated Evaluation. We leverage GPT-4o as our automated evaluator due to its demonstrated capabilities in assessing human-written text and capturing stylistic nuances. Our primary automated metric is the win percentage, which quantifies how often a method's output is selected by GPT-4o as the best match to the ground truth.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation: We complement the automated evaluation with a human evaluation study on a subset of each dataset. Participants are presented with the original input, the ground truth output, and the outputs generated by each method. They are then asked to select the response that they believe best aligns with the ground truth, using the same criteria as the GPT-4o evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to select the response that best aligns with the ground truth.
